description: Lists single-borrower (SASB) CMBS and CRE CLO deals named in public SEC filings, newest first: issuer, ABS-15G filing date, sponsor, loan and property counts, and filing links. With deal set to a deal name (its shelf and series as the SEC filing prints them) it returns that deal and, for a CRE CLO whose sponsor filed the indenture, the closing-date loan list. Use it for private deals, which file no monthly reports; use get_trust for public trusts. Without a key it says whether a named deal is on file, with its SEC filing and date, and otherwise how many deals are on file.

deal.description: The deal name, as its SEC filing prints the shelf and series (a code name or a former name also works), or an id from a previous answer

limit.description: Deals per call: default 100, up to 400 with a key

q.description: Word starts in the deal, depositor or sponsor name, e.g. "BX" or "TRTX"

year.description: Year of the first ABS-15G filing, e.g. "2026"

name: sasb_clo_deals
title: Single-borrower CMBS and CRE CLO deals
